text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Shuka Sho.
The attention of the massive crowd
gathered at Kyoto Racecourse was on—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motiooon!!
We believe in you! Do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: To think that so many people are supporting me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—All eyes were on Fine Motion.
Expectations that would normally crush anyone.
And yet, time and again, she has—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because those very gazes
are what make Fine Motion who she is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Through mental fortitude, she has always turned expectations into strength. I thought this time would be no different, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I hurriedly chased after her,
she was standing alone.
Her expression looked as though she was holding something back—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, it looks like it.
Because, because—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ufufufu...! Look, I just can't wipe this grin off my face~!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aah, jeez! Hey, Fine!
You have to smile in front of everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: At this rate, Shakur's gonna tell me I have a 'dopey smirk on my face'!
choice_data_list: Um, what are you anxious about...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Disappointing the crowd,
of course!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited for the race,
I feel like I'll run with pure joy.
Just like a wild beast!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The name of the dog I used to live with!
He was super mischievous, so his name was Wild!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the audience is expecting
a graceful run from me."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Suppress the excitement...
so I don't go sprinting around like a wild beast...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, am I a bit out of touch?
choice_data_list: Are you worried about the race itself?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still, showing something different
from what everyone expects of me is....”
choice_data_list: It's fine, I've already shown it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh~?!
choice_data_list: Everyone wants to see you having fun.
Everyone wants to see you having fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The way that girl Fine Motion runs...
it's, like, really amazing.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motiooon!
That was an amazing run!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wherever she went, Fine Motion
fascinated the crowd and gave them dreams.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A dream...

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still, caught up in your running...
I actually had a little fun. I'll do my best
so I can feel that way again...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was always just on the receiving end...
But by running, I can give something back too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
I'm gonna have as much fun as I can today, too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's run with all our might,
and gaze upon that wonderful view—together with everyone!
